events.reason: Nominated a second GovernorAlpha (0xC4e172459f1E7939D522503B81AFAaC1014CE6F6, proposal threshold lowered from 10M to 2.5M UNI) to replace the original GovernorAlpha (0x5e4be8Bc9637f0EAA1A755019e06A68ce081D58F) as Timelock admin.
The second GovernorAlpha (0xC4e172459f1E7939D522503B81AFAaC1014CE6F6) accepted the Timelock admin role, replacing the original GovernorAlpha.
Migrated the Timelock admin role from the second GovernorAlpha to GovernorBravo (nomination and acceptance in one transaction).
Lowered the delegated UNI threshold required to submit a governance proposal from 2.5M to 1M UNI.

Transferred UniswapV3Factory ownership (protocol fees, fee tiers) from the Timelock to the first fee adapter, V3FeeAdapter (0x5E74C9f42EEd283bFf3744fBD1889d398d40867d), whose fee setter defines a merkle-gated fee schedule that anyone can apply to pools.
Enabled a 1/6 protocol share of each token's swap fees in the WBTC/WETH 0.3% pool.
Enabled a 1/4 protocol share of each token's swap fees in the USDC/WETH 0.05% pool.
Transferred UniswapV3Factory ownership from V3FeeAdapter to the current V3OpenFeeAdapter, which applies its per-tier and per-pool fee schedule to any pool.
